joystick.name: Joystick gait from the programmatic teacher
joystick.goal: Method track for Goal 1 (any_means): smooth physical joystick walking by any effective means. The retained simulation gate below is a method milestone, not completion of the physical goal. Physical delivery progresses in parallel with Goal 2 without waiting for every method gate. Start from the simple programmatic gait (the scripted tripod teacher and its BC clones) and use RL to make it genuinely joystick controllable. Retained simulation method milestone: one policy (or the session controller stack) follows a randomized 60-second joystick command script in MuJoCo with ZERO falls, directions actually followed, and little slip (slip/m no worse than the scripted teacher's measured band, <=~2.9 at the measured plant), across a held-out eval panel (n>=12 episodes, det+sto, DR-0 and own-DR). BC clones and teacher-initialized policies contribute to Goal 1 only; they cannot qualify for demonstration-free Goal 2. The parent goal also requires a visible, interactive joystick simulation demo, a viewable video and a reproducible launch path per RL_GOALS.md; report sim and physical readiness separately and show sim progress without waiting for hardware completion.

amp.name: AMP locomotion from scratch
amp.goal: Method track for Goal 1 (any_means): smooth physical joystick walking by any effective means. The retained simulation gate below is a method milestone, not completion of the physical goal. Physical delivery progresses in parallel with Goal 2 without waiting for every method gate. Implement the AMP program in rl_docs/AMP_LOCOMOTION.md: adversarial motion priors + massively parallel PPO + privileged critic + observation history + actuator/fault randomization, trained from scratch on the existing MJX GPU stack (no Isaac Lab). The demonstration gait is training data, not the controller. Build every tool it needs (motion library, discriminator, GRU actor, joystick command env, eval suite) and do not pause on operator input. Retained simulation method milestone: milestone M5 (MuJoCo cross-engine transfer of the M2-M4 policy) passes per the brief; M6 hardware deployment is handed to the serialized Robot Lab guarded runner. Random network initialization does not make AMP demonstration-free: its motion-prior training data means this method cannot qualify for Goal 2. The parent goal also requires a visible, interactive joystick simulation demo, a viewable video and a reproducible launch path per RL_GOALS.md; report sim and physical readiness separately and show sim progress without waiting for hardware completion.

walkcurr.name: Prior-free full gait and stance curriculum
walkcurr.goal: Method track for Goal 2 (rl_only), expanded by the operator on 2026-09-13: deliver a complete clean-RL control sequence on the corrected mesh model at the deployable 50 Hz rate: grounded start -> rise and stable hold -> full-direction joystick walking -> controlled lower. Full-direction means forward, +/-45, +/-90, +/-135 and reverse headings, both yaw signs, a useful speed range, stops and restarts, with direction actually followed, zero falls and every leg lifting and placing under every sustained command. A restricted forward/near-forward walk role or a demo that omits known failing headings is partial evidence only. One monolithic actor is not required: independently trained clean RL rise/hold/lower and walk roles may be composed by non-motion state-selection/blending plumbing. Every motion-producing role must have an auditable demonstration-free lineage: no BC initialization or anchor, AMP/reference-motion reward, demonstration replay, teacher target, assisted-policy distillation, scripted pose trajectory, scripted gait residual, gait clock or demonstration-trained initialization. Continuation from a verified clean RL checkpoint is allowed; task rewards, curricula, domain randomization, system identification and ordinary safety/state-machine plumbing are allowed. The existing bundle_rlonly_v2 is retained as a forward-walk milestone, not Goal 2 completion. The fifteen closed off-axis mechanism classes remain closed evidence; reopening full-direction work requires a genuinely new structural mechanism, not another dose, seed or schedule variant. Before any mechanism launch, record run-based reward decompositions, expected term changes and a held-out behavioral gate. Use eval and video for verdicts per RESEARCH_RULES; log reward and behavioral trends together. Simulation acceptance requires the complete grounded-to-grounded interactive full-mesh sequence and video before physical handoff; physical acceptance is reported separately under RL_GOALS.md. Goal 1 proceeds independently.
walkcurr.status: OPERATOR-REOPENED 2026-09-13: lifecycle open until a 50 Hz clean-RL stack rises from grounded, holds, follows the full joystick direction/speed/yaw envelope with all six legs and no command exclusions, stops/restarts, and lowers, first in full-mesh simulation and then physically. bundle_rlonly_v2 remains useful forward-walk evidence but is not completion. The prior 15-class off-axis closure still forbids duplicate reward/dose/seed/schedule variants; the next cycle must write a new structural full-direction design and a clean rise/hold/lower curriculum, define the joined gate, then build/test/launch bounded canaries when justified. Separate clean RL roles may be composed; assisted or scripted motion roles may not cross into this track.

cpg.name: Berkeley-style CPG gait search
cpg.goal: Method track for Goal 1 (any_means): smooth physical joystick walking by any effective means. The retained simulation gate below is a method milestone, not completion of the physical goal. Physical delivery progresses in parallel with Goal 2 without waiting for every method gate. Treat the Yang/Levine microrobot result as its own locomotion path: optimize a low-dimensional SE2FootGait/CPG controller with direct MuJoCo behavioral scoring instead of PPO reward learning. Retained simulation method milestone: the best parameterized controller passes a held-out contextual gait gate with zero falls, low loaded-foot slip, correct headings, turns, stops/restarts, and enough robustness to become either a deployable deterministic controller or a pre-registered teacher/motion-library source. Downstream adoption into joystick or AMP must be measured as an A/B fork, not a silent teacher swap. Direct controller search and its teacher/motion-library products belong to Goal 1; they do not establish walking learned entirely through RL for Goal 2. The parent goal also requires a visible, interactive joystick simulation demo, a viewable video and a reproducible launch path per RL_GOALS.md; report sim and physical readiness separately and show sim progress without waiting for hardware completion.

standwalk.name: Mesh-era stance retrain, then teacher distillation into walking
standwalk.goal: Method track for Goal 1 (any_means): smooth physical joystick walking by any effective means. The retained simulation gate below is a method milestone, not completion of the physical goal. Physical delivery progresses in parallel with Goal 2 without waiting for every method gate. Operator registration 08-24 evening. Stage 1: retrain the best rising-and-lowering (stance) capability on the NEW mesh model family at 100 Hz. The legacy stance champion ppo_goal_cw_stance_dr10 is a primitive-family 25 Hz policy and CANNOT be resumed or warm-started (families do not transfer) - rerun/adapt its recipe with env.model_source=mesh + control.hz=100. Stage-1 gate: rise/hold/lower panel on mesh, n>=12, det+sto, DR-0 + own-DR, zero falls/tips, quiet hold, rise/lower tracking comparable to the legacy champion's band (re-measured on mesh). Stage 2: use the stage-1 policy as a TEACHER and distill rise/lower plus the best walking behavior (joystick champion lineage stotight45-seed13, or its mesh-era successor via pre-registered adoption) into ONE mesh-family 100 Hz policy. Retained simulation method milestone: that single policy, starting from sit, rises, follows a randomized 60-second joystick command script with ZERO falls, directions followed, and slip/m within the joystick band (<=~2.9), then lowers back to sit - held-out panel, n>=12, det+sto, DR-0 and own-DR. Teacher distillation belongs to Goal 1 only. A single sit/rise/walk/lower policy is this method's research milestone, not a prerequisite for either parent physical joystick-walking outcome. The parent goal also requires a visible, interactive joystick simulation demo, a viewable video and a reproducible launch path per RL_GOALS.md; report sim and physical readiness separately and show sim progress without waiting for hardware completion.

assistfade.name: Pragmatic assistance-removal walking curriculum (EASIER_WALKING_CURRICULUM.md)
assistfade.goal: Method track for Goal 1 (any_means): smooth physical joystick walking by any effective means. The retained simulation gate below is a method milestone, not completion of the physical goal. Physical delivery progresses in parallel with Goal 2 without waiting for every method gate. Operator directive 2026-09-03/09-05 (rl_docs/EASIER_WALKING_CURRICULUM.md, merged eb736371): reopen the retired from-scratch walking question under a pragmatic assistance-removal scope on REAL mesh/100Hz physics. 'From scratch' means random neural network weights, NOT prior-free; walkcurr's honest prior-free negative result stays untouched and this track never relaunches raw-joint reward-dose or architecture sweeps. Ladder (run only the first unproven rung; advance on a behavioral pass, retreat one rung on a clear aligned failure): 0 proven endpoint (scripted-tripod BC clone / persistent BC anchor - do not rerun), 1 BC init then task-only PPO (no ongoing BC/AMP/imitation), 2 anchor fade from random weights, 3 bounded residuals around the scripted tripod with fading reference, 4 phase/contact only (revisit only with a reverse curriculum + matched run-based mechanism evidence), 5 raw prior-free (retired, never a launch target). Ignition gate per rung (both seeds, det held-out video/eval): sustained forward translation for the full episode, repeated alternating support transitions, all six legs participating with no permanently planted or unloaded leg, zero falls and zero safety terminations, progress_ratio >= 0.35; slip and current recorded but not held to the mature joystick band at ignition. After an ignition pass, harden ONE dimension at a time: speed band, fixed headings, command changes/stops, yaw, then DR/pushes. Retained simulation method milestone: a random-init policy (rung >= 2) passes ignition AND the hardened contextual walking panel (zero falls, six-leg gait validity, teacher-band slip) on video. Process: before any new reward mechanism, record run-based reward decompositions on parent/clone and best/worst lineage checkpoints, expected term changes, and useful support transitions versus known failure behaviors. Retain matched controls and seed replication; held-out eval and video decide the result per RESEARCH_RULES, not a rollout-ranking pytest bank. These research runs remain simulation-only; qualified candidates go to the serialized Robot Lab guarded runner for Goal 1 physical validation. BC, fading anchors, and residuals around scripted gaits cannot qualify for demonstration-free Goal 2, even with random network initialization. The parent goal also requires a visible, interactive joystick simulation demo, a viewable video and a reproducible launch path per RL_GOALS.md; report sim and physical readiness separately and show sim progress without waiting for hardware completion.

speed.name: Fast gait sim-to-real robustness
speed.status: OPERATOR-REDIRECTED 2026-09-13: preserve the best 50 Hz fast frontier, but make real-world survival the current priority. The PS200 hardware tape rolled 16.78 degrees versus 3.32 degrees in matched simulation. Diagnose interacting model errors with a joint, correlated and per-leg-asymmetric frozen-policy search, then compare current DR, wider independent DR and physical-signature-targeted structured DR while holding the gait/reward/actuator contract fixed. Promote only a seed-replicated model that retains >=90% nominal parent speed, passes a held-out >=48-episode robustness panel with zero falls and >=30% less failure-signature roll, then improves the same bounded physical tape through Robot Lab. Prior isolated PS200 probes stay closed; their failure does not close multi-parameter distributional training. Do not wait for perfect telemetry, but incorporate every new hardware channel when available.
speed.goal: Method track for Goal 1 (any_means), redirected by the operator on 2026-09-13 from simulation-only speed chasing to fast-gait sim-to-real robustness. Preserve the measured-speed Pareto frontier and use the strongest corrected-mesh, deployable-50-Hz candidate as the parent. First explain the hardware gap as far as evidence allows: the PS200 physical command tape produced 16.78 degrees peak roll versus 3.32 degrees in matched simulation. Build a reproducible frozen-policy search over physically bounded JOINT combinations of existing uncertainty families, including correlated and per-leg-asymmetric mass/COM/inertia, contact friction/compliance, actuator strength/gain/damping/slew/current, latency/dropout, encoder zero/backlash/deadband, IMU bias/mounting, link length and manufacturing errors. Match the physical roll timing, speed loss, gait/contact asymmetry and current signature where recorded; keep held-out combinations and policies. Then train matched current-DR, wider-independent-DR and structured/correlated-DR arms without changing gait, reward or actuator envelope; an adaptive/adversarial arm is allowed only with a predeclared held-out gate. Discovery uses one seed and every apparent winner must replicate on another before acquisition. Wider DR is not itself success: a simulation candidate retains >=90% of parent nominal speed and >=0.07 m/s at the 0.10 pin, has zero falls/no chronic sacrificed leg, and on >=48 held-out episodes reduces the parent failure-signature peak-roll statistic >=30% while preserving six-leg gait validity >=90% and avoiding skating, excessive current, wrong-way motion or >20% robust speed loss. Replay the exact failed tape in sim but never train/select on it. Cloud cycles are simulation-only. Robot Lab owns three observed <=30-second comparisons under a verified conservative contract; the first physical milestone is zero falls/trips/guard aborts, >=30% lower peak roll than 16.78 degrees, six-leg cycling and median achieved speed >=0.05 m/s with synchronized video and trustworthy current/thermal data. Sim and hardware readiness remain separate. Prior one-factor PS200 probes and the external-roll-torque hardening failure remain closed as those exact mechanisms; they do not prohibit this new interaction/distributional direction. Assisted/BC/teacher methods are allowed because this is any_means and do not qualify for rl_only. Full design and stop rules: rl_docs/tracks/speed/DESIGN.md.
